# GetOpenInbox

> GetOpenInbox is a free, browser-based temporary email service with built-in email authentication checks, incoming-message risk analysis and raw email source inspection.

## Product

- Website: https://getopeninbox.com/
- Cost: Free
- Registration: Not required
- Inbox session: 10 minutes
- Primary use cases: Low-risk registrations, trials, newsletters, login codes and email verification
- Security features: SPF, DKIM and DMARC result display; sender-domain consistency checks; suspicious-link and attachment-name warnings; raw RFC 5322 message viewer
- Scope: These lightweight checks explain common signals but do not guarantee that a message or sender is safe
- Safety: Do not use temporary email for banking, healthcare, password recovery or accounts that require long-term access

## How it works

1. Open the website to create a temporary email address.
2. Copy the address and use it on a third-party website.
3. The inbox checks automatically for incoming messages.
4. Open a message to read it, review its authentication and risk report, or inspect its raw source.

## Email security analysis

GetOpenInbox reports SPF, DKIM and DMARC results found in received headers and checks common sender, link and attachment warning signs. It is an incoming email and header analyzer, not a full SMTP server, open-relay, TLS or port scanner.

## Data lifecycle

Temporary email content expires automatically from object storage. Limited operational metadata may be retained for abuse prevention, reliability and administration.

## Published resources

- [Email Header Analyzer Online — SPF, DKIM, DMARC & Raw Source](https://getopeninbox.com/tools/email-header-analyzer/): Analyze email headers online: receive a test message in a temporary inbox, review SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and inspect raw source. No paste-in headers; ~10 min session.
- [How Long Does a Temporary Email Address Last?](https://getopeninbox.com/guides/how-long-does-temporary-email-last/): Learn how long temporary email sessions last, what happens when they expire, and how to choose a lifespan that matches your task.
- [How Websites Detect Temporary Email — Why Signups Get Blocked](https://getopeninbox.com/guides/how-websites-detect-temporary-email/): Learn the common signals sites use to spot disposable addresses—blocklists, DNS/MX, and behavior—and when temporary email is the wrong choice.
- [Is Temporary Email Safe? Privacy, Security, and Common Risks](https://getopeninbox.com/guides/is-temporary-email-safe/): Learn what temporary email can protect, what it cannot hide, and when an expiring inbox is the wrong choice for security or recovery.
- [Burner Email vs Temporary Email: What’s the Difference?](https://getopeninbox.com/comparisons/burner-email-vs-temporary-email/): Compare burner email, temporary inboxes, aliases, and secondary accounts by lifespan, privacy, recovery, and appropriate use.
- [How to Analyze an Email Header Step by Step](https://getopeninbox.com/developers/analyze-email-headers/): Learn how to read an email header, trace delivery hops, interpret authentication results, and identify warning signs without overclaiming certainty.
- [How to Read SPF, DKIM, and DMARC Results in Email Headers](https://getopeninbox.com/developers/spf-dkim-dmarc-email-headers/): Interpret SPF, DKIM, and DMARC results, understand domain alignment, and learn why authentication passes do not guarantee a safe message.
- [Temporary Email for Testing: A Practical Guide for Developers and QA](https://getopeninbox.com/developers/temporary-email-for-testing/): Learn where temporary inboxes fit in email testing, what they can validate, and when teams need a dedicated test environment instead.
- [What Is a Burner Email? Uses, Benefits, and Limitations](https://getopeninbox.com/guides/what-is-a-burner-email/): Understand what a burner email is, how it differs from a permanent inbox, and when a disposable address is or is not appropriate.
- [What Is a Disposable Email and How Does It Work?](https://getopeninbox.com/guides/what-is-temporary-email/): Learn how disposable email works, when a temporary inbox is useful, and when you should use a permanent email address instead.
- [メールヘッダー解析（オンライン）— SPF・DKIM・DMARCと生ソース](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/tools/email-header-analyzer/): 一時受信箱でテストメールを受け取り、SPF・DKIM・DMARCと生ソースを確認。任意ヘッダー貼り付け非対応。セッションは約10分。
- [一時メールはどのくらい使えますか？](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/guides/how-long-does-temporary-email-last/): 一時メールの有効期間、期限切れ後に起きること、用途に合った期間の選び方を説明します。
- [サイトは一時メールをどう検出する？登録が拒否される理由](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/guides/how-websites-detect-temporary-email/): 使い捨てアドレスを見分ける主な信号（ブロックリスト、DNS/MX、行動）と、一時メールが向かない場面を解説します。
- [一時メールは安全？プライバシーと主なリスク](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/guides/is-temporary-email-safe/): 一時メールが保護できること、隠せない情報、重要な用途に適さない理由を説明します。
- [バーナーメールと一時メールの違い](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/comparisons/burner-email-vs-temporary-email/): バーナーメール、一時受信箱、エイリアス、サブアカウントを期間、復旧、用途で比較します。
- [メールヘッダーを分析する手順](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/developers/analyze-email-headers/): 配信経路、認証結果、警告サインを順番に読み、根拠の範囲内で判断する方法を解説します。
- [メールヘッダーのSPF・DKIM・DMARC結果の読み方](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/developers/spf-dkim-dmarc-email-headers/): SPF、DKIM、DMARC、ドメイン整合性、認証成功が安全を保証しない理由を説明します。
- [テスト用一時メール：開発者とQAの実践ガイド](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/developers/temporary-email-for-testing/): メールテストで一時受信箱が役立つ範囲と、専用テスト環境が必要な場面を解説します。
- [バーナーメールとは？用途、利点、制限](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/guides/what-is-a-burner-email/): バーナーメールの意味、恒久的な受信箱との違い、適切な用途を解説します。
- [使い捨てメールとは？仕組みと使い方](https://getopeninbox.com/ja/guides/what-is-temporary-email/): 使い捨てメールの仕組み、一時受信箱が役立つ場面、恒久的なメールを選ぶべき場面を解説します。
- [在线邮件头分析器 — SPF、DKIM、DMARC 与原始源码](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/tools/email-header-analyzer/): 用临时收件箱接收测试邮件，查看 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 与原始源码。不支持粘贴外部邮件头；会话约 10 分钟。
- [临时邮箱能用多久？](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/guides/how-long-does-temporary-email-last/): 了解临时邮箱会话时长、过期后会发生什么，以及如何按任务选择合适的有效期。
- [网站如何检测临时邮箱？注册为何会被拒绝](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/guides/how-websites-detect-temporary-email/): 了解站点识别一次性地址的常见信号（黑名单、DNS/MX、行为），以及何时不该使用临时邮箱。
- [临时邮箱安全吗？隐私、安全与常见风险](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/guides/is-temporary-email-safe/): 了解临时邮箱能保护什么、不能隐藏什么，以及不应使用它的场景。
- [备用邮箱与临时邮箱有什么区别？](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/comparisons/burner-email-vs-temporary-email/): 从使用期限、隐私、找回和用途对比备用邮箱、临时收件箱、别名与永久账户。
- [如何逐步分析邮件头](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/developers/analyze-email-headers/): 学习追踪投递路径、解释认证结果、识别警告信号，并避免过度断言。
- [如何解读邮件头中的 SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/developers/spf-dkim-dmarc-email-headers/): 了解 SPF、DKIM、DMARC、域名对齐，以及认证通过为何不能保证邮件安全。
- [用于测试的临时邮箱：开发与 QA 实用指南](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/developers/temporary-email-for-testing/): 了解临时收件箱可以验证哪些邮件流程，以及何时需要专用测试环境。

- [什么是一次性邮箱？它如何工作？](https://getopeninbox.com/zh/guides/what-is-temporary-email/): 了解一次性邮箱的工作方式、适用场景，以及何时应该改用长期邮箱。
